policy: category-only; no private filenames, sizes, hashes, or reads

categories.category: Private operational inputs and raw outputs
categories.reason: Fixture data, credentials, cookies/session/storage, pointers, private detail inventories, raw contacts, auth/TEMP and PostgreSQL logs, private failure DOM and full-contact captures remain excluded, including hash-only copies.
Only the released exact public allowlist was copied. Generic basename literals already present in public harness code describe its contract and do not constitute copied private input artifacts.
A labeled public clone replaces unnecessary pointer path prose with a category token; released-public and clone digests are mapped separately.
Verifier, outputs and logs are outside the evidence index and control-file seals to avoid self-sealing.
